hexbubbles.page.title: Carver's Gambit
hexbubbles.page.automation.1: Accepts the pattern to be written to the slate and its location. Costs no media
hexbubbles.page.automation.2: I have grown tired of writing patterns to individual slates as I place them like a bricklayer applying mortar.$(br2)This pattern will allow to write patterns to slates after I have placed them.$(br2)Combined with the right spell, this will allow me to rapidly copy a list of patterns to a circle.
